Callout.Name: Lorry Collision
Callout.Message: Two lorries in collision, carriageway blocked.
Callout.Advisory: Both drivers out and walking, load spilled.

Script.Line: Two lorries and they are blocking everything.
One driver is out and the other one is still in the cab.
There is diesel on the road and a trailer across two lanes.

Lines.Approach: Both drivers are out and walking, which is remarkable given the state of the cabs.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
